output.one_liner: Ecwid is a SaaS ecommerce platform providing REST APIs and webhooks to build custom apps and manage store data, orders, products, customers, and payments.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 is used for app authorization. Bearer tokens (static secret tokens) are used to authenticate REST API requests.

evidence.snippet: We use OAuth 2.0 authorization simplified for single-store customizations

access.notes: Pages reference 'Set up your dev environment in Ecwid' and 'Make your first API request' but do not explicitly state whether the API is free, requires payment, is trial-based, or needs approval.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 600 requests per minute per token; requests exceeding the limit receive 429 error with Retry-After header

evidence.snippet: Ecwid REST API allows you to access and manage any store data
We accept up to 600 requests per minute per token
Ecwid webhooks are automatic real-time notifications for apps about different events
Store Profile, Orders, Products, Categories, Customers, Discounts, Domains, Dictionaries

buildability.rationale: REST API and webhooks are well-documented with broad endpoint coverage, but the credential acquisition process and access status (free vs. paid vs. approval required) are not documented in the provided pages.

overview_evidence.snippet: Build with Ecwid apps | Ecwid Documentation
Ecwid REST API allows you to access and manage any store data, payment and shipping methods

unknown_reasons.auth: Pages specify OAuth 2.0 and Bearer tokens but do not document specific OAuth grant types supported.
unknown_reasons.access: Pages do not state whether free tier is available, payment is required, trial-based access is offered, admin approval is needed, or app review is required for production use.
unknown_reasons.api_surface: OpenAPI/Swagger specification URL not provided in pages; full endpoint inventory not exhaustively listed.
unknown_reasons.mcp: No MCP server (official or community) mentioned in provided documentation pages.
